comment: What `npm run build` reads, declared by the half of the repo that owns it.
`stack.py status` reads this to date `dist/.built` against the tree; declaring it
here means infra/ does not need to enumerate web/'s layout by hand.
`exclude` is what lives under an included path without reaching the bundle:
documentation, and the tests vitest runs but vite does not bundle. Editing one
changes no byte of `dist/`, so it must not report the build stale.
